purpose: Migration ledger reconciling the version-controlled branch-protection contract (config/ci/required-status-checks.json) with what is actually enforced on GitHub. Every context declared under required_status_checks that is NOT live-enforced MUST be listed below with status and owner. The daily branch-protection-validation cron intentionally does NOT pass this file, so a declared-but-unapplied context keeps the cron red until the migration is applied. Policy-changing PRs run the validator WITH this file so pre-existing documented gaps do not block unrelated policy work, while any missing context not represented here fails the PR.
